title: not perfect, cooking not even, messy clean-up
text:
not perfect, cooking not even, messy clean-up. It takes a bit to get the bacon hung up, it doesn't cook it 100% even, and it makes a mess to clean up.

I think it is easier to cook bacon in a skillet. Sorry. I also buy pre-cooked bacon and heat it up in the microwave. This is much easier for us.
